items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: But Jellie didn't like De Paris as a trumpet player.

ctx.x: That's when he got Bichet with him and Nicholas and De Paris.

But Jellie didn't like De Paris as a trumpet player. He liked him as a player, but he was an obstinate man, I think. He didn't like to be told how to play or why I think. That's the best I can gather from it. Jellie never mentioned his name, but in talking about it later, he says the trumpet player did his best to spoil things or something like that. He said he didn't want to follow instructions, I don't know why.
Well, I guess they figured George Jellie, being the way he was, he came up there, you know. He knew more buzz than any of them and they didn't.
